senses.gloss: m. (תִּקֵּן) perfected, well-arranged, finished, esp. fruits properly tithed.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Demai 4:7">Dem. IV, 7</cite> <he>אינו מ׳</he> the tithes have not been given of it.
Nidd. 15ᵇ, a. fr. חזקה אין חבר מוציא … דבר שאינו מ׳ the presumption is that a ḥaber will not let go out of his hands anything not perfected (according to law); a. fr.—Pl. מְתוּקָּנִים, מְתוּקָּנִין.
<cite ref="Yoma 71a:14">Yoma 71ᵃ</cite> <he>חיים … ומ׳</he> a prolonged, blessed and perfect life.
